articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Lǎo Sòng, zěnmeyàng? Máng ne?
MR. ANDERSON: Sòng, how are things going? Busy?
SÒNG TÓNGZHÌ: Bù zěnme máng. Nǐ yǒu shì ma?
COMRADE SÒNG: Not especially busy. Can I do something for you?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ Sìyuè Shísìhào yào dào Guǎngzhōu qù. Qǐng ni gěi wo dìng yìzhāng fēijī piào.
MR. ANDERSON: I'm going to Guǎngzhōu on April 14. Please reserve a plane ticket for me.
SÒNG TÓNGZHÌ: Hǎo. Piào dìnghǎo le. Jiǔdiǎn shíwǔfēn qǐfēi.
COMRADE SÒNG: Sure. The ticket has been reserved. It takes off at 9:15.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Zhèibān fēijī zhí fēi Guǎngzhōu ma?
MR. ANDERSON: Does this flight go directly to Guǎngzhōu?
SÒNG TÓNGZHÌ: Shì, zhí fēi Guǎngzhōu.
COMRADE SÒNG: Yes, it flies directly to Guǎngzhōu.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Qǐng ni míngtian zǎoshang pài ge chē lái jiē wo.
MR. ANDERSON: Please send a car to pick me up tomorrow morning.
SÒNG TÓNGZHÌ: Hǎo. Wǒ pài chē sòng ni dào fēijīchǎng qu.
COMRADE SÒNG: Okay. I'll send a car to take you to the airport.
